Houston, you know Sarper Güven from *90 Day Fiancé: The Other Way*.  

He started stand-up in 2025, bringing high-energy stories about marriage, life between Turkey and America, and reality TV. He keeps it physical, talks with the crowd, and tries new jokes in the room. If you like comedy that feels personal without getting too dark, I’d see this one.  

Punch Line Houston · Monday, October 19, 2026

Houston, Foos Gone Wild co-created the original music for will.i.am’s “SICK ASS FOO’S.”

The comedy comes from barrio satire, voice-over roasting, cartoons, music, and the kind of foo stories you either know or you don’t. It began as an Instagram page in 2018, built around user clips and sharp captions. I’d bring the friend who gets the lowrider jokes, party-line memories, and G-funk references.

Houston, if you caught Joanne McNally on *Taskmaster* Series 17, you already know she does not take the safe route.

Her *Pinotphile* tour is coming to Punch Line Houston. She tells personal stories about dating, friendship, nights out, and Irish life with quick timing and no polished front. I’d bring the friend who likes comedy candid and a little rowdy.

Houston, Josh Gondelman released his 2025 special, *Positive Reinforcement*, on YouTube.

He makes warm, joke-dense stand-up out of adult life, family, and the everyday stuff most people miss. He began doing Boston open mics in 2004, and his official bio lists *Conan*, *Late Night with Seth Meyers*, and *The Late Late Show with James Corden*. I’d go for the smart writing and the friendly, non-aggressive style.

Punch Line Houston · Thursday, October 22, 2026

Houston, you remember Pauly Shore from MTV’s Totally Pauly.

He’s bringing The Weasel to Punch Line Houston, with loose crowd questions and riffs that make his live sets feel different from the old clips. He’s been performing stand-up since 1985. If you grew up on MTV-era energy—or like a comic who talks with the room—catch this one.
